post.summary: Generate or edit an image with AI (chatimg.ai)
post.description: Transform a source image with an AI model and prompt (e.g. style transfer, editing). Requires an API token (Authorization: Bearer <token>). Billing: charged from your chatimg.ai credits per image — openai: 25 credits, gpt-image-2: 50 credits, flux: 12 credits, gemini: 10 credits, nanobanana-pro: 30 credits, nanobanana-2-lite: 12 credits, nanobanana-2: 20 credits, grok: 30 credits, seedream: 15 credits, qwen: 8 credits, z-image-turbo: 5 credits, flux-2-flex: 25 credits. See GET /v1/imagePricing for machine-readable pricing. Generation is asynchronous: poll GET /v1/imageStatus with the same imageUrl until status is completed. Failed generations are automatically refunded.

imageUrl.description: URL of the source image to process. Supports http URLs and base64 encoded images (with or without data:image/... prefix)

prompt.description: Prompt describing the desired transformation (default: ghibli style)

model.description: AI model to use (default: nanobanana-2-lite). Pricing per image: openai: 25 credits, gpt-image-2: 50 credits, flux: 12 credits, gemini: 10 credits, nanobanana-pro: 30 credits, nanobanana-2-lite: 12 credits, nanobanana-2: 20 credits, grok: 30 credits, seedream: 15 credits, qwen: 8 credits, z-image-turbo: 5 credits, flux-2-flex: 25 credits

taskId.description: Unique identifier for the generation task

status.description: Initial status of the generation task (pending)

imageUrl.description: The source image URL, used as the key when polling /v1/imageStatus

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the task was created

balanceRemaining.description: Remaining credits balance after this charge

get.summary: Get the status of an image generation task
get.description: Poll the status of a generation started via POST /v1/generateImage, keyed by the source imageUrl. Read-only and free of charge. When completed, `generatedImageUrl` holds the result image.

parameters.name: imageUrl

schema.description: The source image URL passed to /v1/generateImage

parameters.description: The source image URL passed to /v1/generateImage

status.description: Current status of the generation task

imageUrl.description: URL of the image to check status for

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the task was created

error.description: Error message of the generation task

taskId.description: Unique identifier for the generation task

get.summary: List available image models and their credits pricing
get.description: Machine-readable pricing for POST /v1/generateImage: per-image credits price of each model, plus one-time credits top-up packs. No authentication required.

model.description: Model identifier, pass as the `model` param of /v1/generateImage

models.description: Per-image credits price of each available model

creditPacks.description: One-time credits top-up packs (purchase at https://chatimg.ai/pricing)
